Cusco · Perú

Rumiqolqa Gateway

An old gateway on the southern route

Current ratingsOpening hoursView the place on the map
Nearby places

Explore

This monumental gateway lies on the southern approach to the Cusco basin near Pikillacta. The opening frames the road corridor, making the site a useful contrast to the enclosed streets inside the nearby Wari settlement.

Planning your visit

20–40 min · Allow this time for the visit itself. Add travel, admission queues and any scheduled tour separately.

History and local experience

A gateway is understood from both directions. Look back after passing the viewing point to see how the opening narrows and then releases the surrounding valley view.

Walking route

  1. Portada de Rumiqolqa, Lucre, Quispicanchi
  2. Use the designated roadside access, approach the opening from the visitor path and step sideways to see wall thickness.
  3. Arrange a safe pickup away from moving highway traffic.
